snippet.title: NOMIA Beta Trailer
snippet.description:
NOMIA is an isometric tactics game in development by one member of Magnesium Ninja Studios.
It's Final Fantasy Tactics meets Slay the Spire. 

Wishlist on Steam here! https://store.steampowered.com/app/3608900/NOMIA/
You can play it in development here! https://magnesiumninja.itch.io/nomia

Two heroes, two hands; no one should die the same way twice. Dive deep into the Dream, and play your cards well.

Music by Will Goss: https://willgoss.com/
